source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Gambit (archived 12 January 2018)

powerOrigins.detail: Born a mutant who converts the potential energy stored in objects into explosive kinetic energy.

abilities.name: Kinetic charging
abilities.detail: Charges objects by touch so they explode; a charged playing card bursts with the force of a grenade, and larger objects take longer.

abilities.name: Enhanced conditioning
abilities.detail: His constant inner charge sharpens speed, strength, reflexes and agility, letting him dodge bullets and lasers.

abilities.name: Hypnotic charm
abilities.detail: A subtle psionic pull in his voice makes people inclined to believe and agree with him, though strong or wary minds resist.

abilities.name: Telepathic static
abilities.detail: The charge in his body creates static that shields his mind from telepaths, stronger with a charged object near his head.

abilities.name: Thrown-weapon mastery
abilities.detail: Throws cards, knives, bolas and balls with great accuracy, his cards serving as long-range explosive projectiles.

abilities.name: Staff fighting and martial arts
abilities.detail: A master of the bo staff who also uses savate, street fighting and acrobatics.

abilities.name: Master thief and strategist
abilities.detail: A trained thief and lockpick, and a natural strategist the wiki rates among the best of the X-Men.

feats.text: Caught a bullet in flight and threw it back.
At the height of his power, triggered the charging process in objects from a distance with nothing but eye contact.
Spotted a magical bullet heading for his eye and knocked it out of the air moments before it struck.
Threw a single charged card across the Resistance hideout and shattered the liquor bottle in Wolverine's hand.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Deadpool & Wolverine

feats.text: In the assault on Cassandra Nova's lair, stuck charged cards on several henchmen and detonated them all at once.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Deadpool & Wolverine

feats.text: After a hammer blow sent him flying, he got up, charged his bo staff and drove it into his attacker, who exploded.
